translation: In all cases where the chest bone is struck and knocked or fallen upon from the front by an object, it is severe; when struck or fallen upon from behind, it is mild. For mild cases, first treat according to the pattern with manual technique, then administer Zhenggu Zijin Dan (Bone-Setting Purple-Gold Pill, 正骨紫金丹) internally, and externally iron on Dingtong San (Pain-Relieving Powder, 定痛散) mixed with wheat bran (面麩), or wash it with Haitongpi Tang (Erythrina Bark Decoction, 海桐皮湯), and apply Wanling Gao (Myriad-Efficacy Plaster, 萬靈膏), and one may obtain a cure. If blood stasis accumulates internally with swelling and pain, and the person is bent over and cannot look up, in the morning treat with Qingshang Yuxue Tang (Clearing the Upper and Dispersing Blood Decoction, 清上瘀血湯) and Xiaoxia Poxue Tang (Dispersing the Lower and Breaking Blood Decoction, 消下破血湯), dividing treatment by the upper diaphragm and the lower diaphragm, and in the evening take Shuxue Wan (Blood-Dispersing Pill, 疏血丸).
